scope: Read-only review of main .github/workflows/ci.yml GPT conversion job against convert worker's manifest and ignored tests; no builds or downloads
conclusions: PowerShell download loop selects the exact model_origins.gpt2 and model_origins.gptneox records. All 13 URL, path, size and SHA-256 entries match the input descriptors used by the ignored tests.

All URLs bind the expected repository and immutable 40-character revision. Each curl result is checked immediately; complete size and lowercase SHA-256 are verified after transfer. The one-MiB minimum transfer ceiling allows small-file redirect responses while exact final sizes remain enforced.
The downloader and test step use the same runner.temp/gpt-converter-inputs/{gpt2,gptneox}/official-hf paths. The directory basenames preserve the captured converter naming behavior.

runner.temp appears in step-level environment values, with the job configured for PowerShell on each independent Ubuntu/Windows runner. Shared compile policy and pinned toolchain installation match the surrounding workflow.

LLAMA_TEST_GPT2_FILTERED_HF is intentionally unset on the fresh hosted runner, so the ignored GPT-2 test builds the hash-pinned derivative through Rust under the unique output root. GPT-2 original rejection, its three accepted derivative files, and all three NeoX files are covered.

The final command names gpt_pretrained explicitly and runs release, offline, locked, ignored tests with test-threads=1. Both tests share only the fresh parent output root and use distinct output subdirectories; input hashes are checked again before and after conversion.
qualifications: This review is structural/source validation, not a completed hosted Actions run. Parent's parser/static-checker and integrated executions remain separate evidence.
No workflow or product source was modified by this reviewer.
